event_source_policy_snapshot_historical_.question: At fixed corresponding focal observations, does replacing a 1/2-source-edge endpoint budget with metric-specific turn-event endpoints and the existing arc-length cap preserve the enumerated geometric witness decisions under pure source-edge subdivision?
event_source_policy_snapshot_historical_.scope: One synthetic square counterexample and seven fixed report-named real focal comparisons; no full-pool regrouping, no majority update, no center movement, no reference/GT read
event_source_policy_snapshot_historical_.search_domain: Each direction from the retained focal, propose every source vertex that is a turn event in any compared boundary, within 120 degrees cumulative arc length on every compared boundary. Preserve full source sequence between focal and endpoint. Reject any combined two-sided paths covering a complete source cycle.

metric_event_rule.pair: union of top and bottom turns at original paired source positions; no interior cross-side identity inferred

event_source_policy_snapshot_historical_.stopping_condition: Finish all declared original/subdivision runs and tests; report every outcome, domain failure and mismatch; do not tune gates, budgets or window selection after outcomes
event_source_policy_snapshot_historical_.source_observations_and_votes: Source inputs remain byte-identical. Synthetic subdivisions are same-record metamorphic probes, never additional annotators or votes. Event compression is only a search representation, never deletion or identity certification.
event_source_policy_snapshot_historical_.claim_limit: Exact subdivision invariance is conditional on unambiguous ordered minor arcs, exact same-curve subdivisions, and fixed corresponding focal observations. Floating point tests support only the listed finite cases; collinearity below tolerance and degenerate arcs are not semantically certified.

event_applied_rule: Each direction from the retained focal, propose every source vertex that is a turn event in any compared boundary, within 120 degrees cumulative arc length on every compared boundary. Preserve full source sequence between focal and endpoint. Reject any combined two-sided paths covering a complete source cycle.
human_review: read only after saving all automatic candidates; exposed development cases
scope_note: five targeted hard cases plus four exposed/ordinary cases; not random/blind test
stopping_condition: all nine images x three fixed gates x five policies plus posthoc relation accounting
